name: Direct IAM write scoped by NotResource (boundary)
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN with a NotResource scope. Allow iam:PutUserPolicy + iam:AttachRolePolicy on NotResource (everything EXCEPT one protected role) still grants direct self-administration, so DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN fires; the NotResource 'allow everything except' shape is broad, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE also fires (subsumed into DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN in the authoritative table per IAM-201). Provides the DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN NotResource cell of the per-rule matrix.
